pipeline: Remove Mn marks whose most recent non-Mark base has Script=Latin
profiles.empty_policy: Drop empty normalized terms; preserve a nonempty original when requested
profiles.conformance: Search equivalence profile, not complete UTS #39 Unicode 17 bidi skeleton conformance

pipeline: Offline: enumerate every Unicode scalar and apply ICU SpoofChecker.getSkeleton until fixed point; require convergence within 16 passes
Group scalars by nonempty fixed-point skeleton and include that skeleton spelling; retain groups with at least two members
Require every group to be prefix-free; sort spellings by UTF-16 code units
Runtime: longest-leftmost segmentation by group spellings; copy unmatched Unicode scalars
Emit original, then all substitutions at up to max_changed_positions distinct matched spans
profiles.ordering: Original first; then changed-span count, ascending span-index tuples, and alternative spellings in UTF-16 lexicographic order with the rightmost alternative varying fastest
profiles.preserve_original: Original is intrinsic to expansion and always emitted once; preserve_original does not alter this profile
profiles.case_and_accents: No case folding or accent stripping; apply separate filters explicitly if needed
profiles.empty_policy: Drop empty input unless keyword-marked; no expansion spelling is empty
profiles.limits: Default max_changed_positions=1, range 1..4; max_output_tokens_per_input=1024 and existing byte, stream, attribute and shared memory ceilings
profiles.conformance: Pinned ICU fixed-point substitution policy, not exhaustive Unicode string inversion or Unicode 17 bidi skeleton conformance
